title: Use Postgres + pgvector as the primary store
question: Need a durable relational store that also supports vector similarity for council memory recall + RH knowledge graph. Candidates: Postgres + pgvector, Pinecone + Postgres, Weaviate standalone.
synthesis: Postgres 17 with pgvector. Single operational footprint, transactional integrity, ivfflat cosine index. Trade-off: lower-bound recall vs dedicated vector DBs at >1M rows, mitigated by re-tuning lists param post-volume.
context: council memory layer + RH memory_procedural share one DB instance to avoid two-database ops overhead

title: Advisor pattern as default for new agents
question: How should new autonomous agents balance cost vs quality? Single high-end model = expensive. Single low-end model = miss judgment calls.
synthesis: Sonnet executor + Opus advisor pattern. Executor handles mechanical turns (read files, run cmds). Advisor consulted at decision points only (architectural choices, hard debugging, final synthesis). Shared conversation context via Anthropic's advisor-tool-2026-03-01 beta. ~60-80% cost cut at parity quality on long-horizon agentic work.
context: Anthropic Building Effective Agents blog + ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md advisor-pattern section

title: PEP 657 — Include Fine Grained Error Locations in Tracebacks
question: Should Python tracebacks include column offsets to disambiguate which expression within a line raised? Cost: ~2-5% startup memory increase, additional bytecode metadata.
synthesis: Accepted in Python 3.11. Net debuggability win > memory cost. Lesson: per-token positional metadata is cheap enough at modern memory budgets that the precision-vs-overhead tradeoff almost always favors precision when the debug signal is high.
context: Python language design — error reporting precision tradeoff

title: Knight Capital 2012 — $440M deployment loss
question: How did an automated trading firm lose $440M in 45 minutes from a deployment?
synthesis: Old SMARS code (deployed on 7 of 8 servers) reactivated by a config flag that the new deployment repurposed. Lesson: feature flags must be one-way per release; never reuse a flag name across deployments where the meaning changes. Deployment validation must touch ALL servers, not a representative sample. Kill-switches must be the FIRST thing rolled forward, not the last.
context: high-frequency trading deployment + config flag reuse

title: Orchestrator-Workers Agent Pattern
question: When should an agent be split into a central orchestrator + multiple workers vs. one monolithic agent?
synthesis: Use orchestrator-workers when (a) work decomposes cleanly into parallel subtasks, (b) per-subtask context can be scoped to a fresh worker (no shared mutable state), (c) workers can return structured results the orchestrator merges. Avoid when subtasks share rapidly-mutating state or when latency dominates (orchestrator round-trip is overhead). Pattern beats monolith on token cost when worker count > 3 and tasks are mostly independent.
context: Anthropic Building Effective Agents — agent design patterns catalog
